changeSet.author: desafio-matriculas
changeSet.comment: Garante codigo da turma no padrao DISCIPLINA-Tn (ex.: CC-ALG-T1)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE t SET t.codigo = d.codigo + N'-' + CASE WHEN t.vagas_totais >= 40 THEN N'T1' ELSE N'T2' END, t.atualizado_em = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM turma t INNER JOIN disciplina d ON d.id = t.disciplina_id WHERE t.codigo NOT LIKE d.codigo + N'-%';
